response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Ties in average compression ratio are left in arbitrary order since the request gives no tiebreaker.

Averages are computed with plain AVG, which ignores NULLs, and are not rounded or cast; scancount is integer so AVG may yield a decimal depending on the SQL dialect (it does in PostgreSQL and SQLite).
